mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMO_ID, M.FOLDER_ID, M.TITLE, M.CONTENT, M.CREATED_AT, M.UPDATED_AT FROM MEMO M INNER JOIN MEMO_FOLDER F ON F.FOLDER_ID = M.FOLDER_ID WHERE F.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY M.UPDATED_AT DESC, M.MEMO_ID DESC
SELECT M.MEMO_ID, M.FOLDER_ID, M.TITLE, M.CONTENT, M.CREATED_AT, M.UPDATED_AT FROM MEMO M INNER JOIN MEMO_FOLDER F ON F.FOLDER_ID = M.FOLDER_ID WHERE M.MEMO_ID = #{memoId} AND F.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMO SET TITLE = #{memo.title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CONTENT = #{memo.content, jdbcType=CLOB}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MEMO_ID = #{memo.memoId} AND FOLDER_ID IN ( SELECT FOLDER_ID FROM MEMO_FOLDER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} )
